summary: Context-only committee read: the macro state is mixed and transitioning, with US Q2 reflation confidence low (0.20), contracting liquidity, restrictive/rising real yields, but healthy breadth, tight credit, and no recession signal. The risk radar is at caution because of a rising bubble/blow-off scare (71.2), yet its broad-tape context gate is unmet and the measured 21-day >=5% SPY pullback rate is 16.0% versus a 17.8% base rate. This makes the radar an early attention condition, not an established edge. Factor intelligence is not mature: only 10 panel dates, history floor unmet, Pair G dormant, zero graded factor-attention events, and the composite is non-tradeable. The graded spine sample returned was dominated by context-only Canadian-board unsigned MFE proxies and should not be interpreted as directional validation. Kernel review shows no engine is armed; notably the US board loses out of sample in Q2 at five days, radar has negative 21-day signed excess in the available Q1 history, and thematic/stock desks have negative 63-day signed excess. No new hypothesis was staked because the available evidence did not justify spending the limited metabolism budget.

contradictions_review: Six current contradiction edges were reviewed. The core macro tension is Q2 reflation versus a caution risk radar dominated by bubble risk; this is a label tension rather than proof of impending drawdown because breadth is healthy and the radar state's measured pullback rate is below base. Bonds and FX contradict the Q2 equity regime, while the cross-asset layer reports divergence. Thirty-two ticker-level demand-versus-supply divergences remain display-only. Rising put skew contradicts nine buy-lane names, but the stated prior says bullish skew deceleration is unsupported; this can only de-escalate existing conviction. Pair G has no records because the factor panel has not reached 60 dates. Open master-brain theses requiring attention include the overdue China-equities overweight, overdue long-Treasuries overweight, and near-due US-equities underweight; each conflicts with at least part of the current contradiction set or its own falsifier conditions.
